lines.speaker: folkwang
lines.text: Yeouch! Hot, hot, hot!

lines.speaker: folkwang
lines.text: My phone is overheating.

lines.speaker: folkwang
lines.text: Sorry, it was so hot that I forgot to say hello! :P

lines.speaker: folkwang
lines.text: Hi there.
Hi.

lines.speaker: folkwang
lines.text: I'm Folkwang from Nepenthe.

lines.speaker: folkwang
lines.text: Do you suffer from excessive perspiration by any chance?
No more than any other person.

lines.speaker: folkwang
lines.text: Aw man, I envy you!

lines.speaker: folkwang
lines.text: I've been loading up on Ice Splendamin and supplements,

lines.speaker: folkwang
lines.text: but that hasn't changed a thing.

lines.speaker: folkwang
lines.text: Tell me, what does not sweating feel like?

lines.speaker: folkwang
lines.text: It sounds like it'd feel so... clean.

lines.speaker: folkwang
lines.text: The more I think about it, the more I envy you, and that only turns on the spigot more.

lines.speaker: folkwang
lines.text: What do you usually do when you're sweating a lot?

lines.speaker: folkwang
lines.text: If you have any tips, I'd love to hear them.
I just take off my clothes all day long.
I'd soak myself in some cool water all day long.

lines.speaker: folkwang
lines.text: Whoa... sorry, but that just made me sweat even more.

lines.speaker: folkwang
lines.text: Just thinking about cool water on my skin... makes me sweat even more.

lines.speaker: folkwang
lines.text: It's a good idea, but not very feasible to do all day every day.

lines.speaker: folkwang
lines.text: If you happen to think of any ideas in the future, please let me know.
Sure.

lines.speaker: folkwang
lines.text: Ugh, it's time!

lines.speaker: folkwang
lines.text: Nutritional supplements are on sale! I gotta go!
A sale?

lines.speaker: folkwang
lines.text: Yeah, there's this great supplement that improves your constitution,

lines.speaker: folkwang
lines.text: and it's sold at half price today!

lines.speaker: folkwang
lines.text: It's always sold out every time I try to buy it :(

lines.speaker: folkwang
lines.text: So I really need to buy some today!

lines.speaker: folkwang
lines.text: Want me to buy some for you too?
Thanks, but no thanks.

lines.speaker: folkwang
lines.text: Okay. After all, I may not even be able to buy enough for myself...

lines.speaker: folkwang
lines.text: If I can snag some, I'll let you know how it turns out after I take them.

lines.speaker: folkwang
lines.text: Oh man, the sale's gonna start any minute now! Gotta go.

lines.speaker: folkwang
lines.text: It was nice talking with you!
